# sendgrid_event_webhook (Resource)

Manages a SendGrid Event Webhook configuration. Accounts on plans that support multiple webhooks may have more than one `sendgrid_event_webhook` resource, each with a distinct `url`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "sendgrid_event_webhook" "delivery_events" {
  url       = "https://example.com/webhooks/sendgrid"
  enabled   = true
  delivered = true
  bounce    = true
  dropped   = true
  signed    = true
}

# Use this to verify the signature on incoming requests.
output "sendgrid_webhook_public_key" {
  value = sendgrid_event_webhook.delivery_events.public_key
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `url` (String) The URL SendGrid will POST event data to. No two webhooks may share a URL.

### Optional

- `bounce` (Boolean) Receive bounce events.
- `click` (Boolean) Receive click events. Requires Click Tracking.
- `deferred` (Boolean) Receive deferred events.
- `delivered` (Boolean) Receive delivered events.
- `dropped` (Boolean) Receive dropped events.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether this Event Webhook is enabled.
- `friendly_name` (String) An optional, non-unique friendly name for this webhook.
- `group_resubscribe` (Boolean) Receive group resubscribe events. Requires Subscription Tracking.
- `group_unsubscribe` (Boolean) Receive group unsubscribe events. Requires Subscription Tracking.
- `oauth_client_id` (String) OAuth client ID SendGrid uses to generate an access token for this webhook.
- `oauth_client_secret` (String, Sensitive) OAuth client secret. Write-only: SendGrid never returns this value back.
- `oauth_token_url` (String) URL SendGrid sends the OAuth client ID and secret to in order to generate an access token.
- `open` (Boolean) Receive open events. Requires Open Tracking.
- `processed` (Boolean) Receive processed events.
- `signed` (Boolean) Whether signature verification is enabled for this webhook.
- `spam_report` (Boolean) Receive spam report events.
- `unsubscribe` (Boolean) Receive unsubscribe events. Requires Subscription Tracking.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The Event Webhook's ID.
- `public_key` (String) The public key used to verify this webhook's request signatures. Only set when `signed` is `true`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import sendgrid_event_webhook.delivery_events <webhook_id>
```
